dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (JMA standard receipt software), likely compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux; uses MCPAREA/MCPDATA copybooks and ORCDBMAIN call pattern typical of JMA ORCA

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA medical insurance subscriber (hknjainf) master update processing — inserts, updates, and deletes insured-person records in the tbl_hknjainf database table
purpose.summary: This program is a batch subprogram in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that processes insured-person (hknjainf) master file updates. It reads an input file of change records, evaluates the operation type (Insert/Update/Delete), performs the corresponding DB operation via the ORCDBMAIN interface, and writes error and proof-list output files.

notable_features: LINKAGE SECTION with LNK-AREA (called as subprogram)
COPY-based record definitions (CPHKNJAINFWK.INC, CPHKNJAINF.INC, CPSK1001.INC, CPJOBKANRI.INC, MCPAREA, MCPDATA.INC, CPMUPLINK.INC, CPORCSNUM.INC)
MCP-FUNC DB interface (DBSELECT, DBINSERT) via ORCDBMAIN
LINE SEQUENTIAL file I/O for input, error, and proof-list files
Japanese comments encoded in latin-1 (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS garbled)
grpsys-prefixed lines (conditional compilation or group marker)
STRING verb for dynamic file path construction
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: Japanese comments are garbled due to latin-1 decoding of what is likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS encoding. The 'grpsys' prefix on some lines appears to be a source-level group/conditional marker used in the JMA ORCA build system. File is truncated at 16000 chars but enough structure is visible for confident classification.
